description: Fill a kit's sounds from the free CC0 library first: each sound without a take is searched by its name and length, and a full match becomes its take in use, free. Answers what matched (let the user listen), the nearest sounds for others (use_library_sound to use one) and the gaps to make with make_kit_sounds.

kit_id.description: The kit id from start_game_kit or add_kit_sounds (kit_…).

sound_ids.description: Only these sounds (default: every sound without a take).

name: fill_kit_from_library
